title: Immunization Services Scheduling Standard — Phone Appointments for the Next Series Dose
content:
Store Operations scheduling standard, Kestrel Pharmacy Immunization Services. A phone appointment for the next dose of a vaccination series is booked on the patient's course of that vaccination, for one dose, at one Kestrel store, a whole number of calendar days after today and at a start time the patient chose.

## Standing conditions

> An appointment for the next dose of a series is not booked until a screening and consent form for that dose stands signed on the open course of the vaccination.

> Before the days ahead of that appointment are fixed, every dose on the series history given sooner than its minimum interval less the grace period must carry its invalidation entry.

As states of the record, these read: the open course of the vaccination shows a signed screening and consent form for the dose the appointment is for; and every dose on the series history that was given sooner than its minimum interval less the grace period shows its invalidation entry. The appointment is not booked, and its days ahead are not fixed, while the record does not show those states.

## The booking action

**Capability.** One call creates one booked appointment for one dose of a patient's vaccination course. The appointment is made today through the phone channel, at the named store, for the named dose, on the date that lies the given number of calendar days after today, at the given start time. The appointment then appears in the course's history as an open appointment.

**How it is invoked.** `book_series_dose_9b68cabc` is an agent-side tool of the Patient Care Desk. It is first unlocked with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then called by name with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`; the agent carries out the booking.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `course_id` | Reference number of the vaccination course the appointment is for, as returned by the course lookup or the course opening | text reference |
| `store_id` | Reference number of the Kestrel store where the dose is given, as returned by the store lookup or the course record | text reference |
| `dose_number` | The dose of the course the appointment is for | a positive whole number |
| `days_ahead` | The appointment date expressed as whole calendar days after today's date in the store's local time; the tool records the resulting date | a whole number from 0 (today) upward |
| `appointment_time` | Start time of the slot, as the patient chose it | HH:MM, 24-hour, store local time |

The booking channel is always phone; there is no channel parameter.

**Return.** A successful call returns a record with `appointment_id` (reference number of the booked appointment), `course_id`, `dose_number`, `appointment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `appointment_time` (HH:MM), `store_id` and `booked_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's date). A returned `appointment_id` means the appointment is booked.

## Points of reading

- **What does the tool itself check?** Nothing. It records the appointment exactly as the values passed to it describe; the dose, the store, the days ahead and the start time are what the caller passes.
- **How is the date recorded?** As today's date plus `days_ahead` calendar days, in YYYY-MM-DD form; a value of 0 is today.
- **What shows afterwards?** The appointment stands on the course history as an open appointment for that dose.
